AboutPage.label: About
AboutPage.text: Kardenum brings development, design, audiovisual production and community services together in one studio.
AboutPage.ideaOrigin: Kardenum comes from kardía, "heart" in Greek. Behind every project there is someone who trusted us. That is why we treat every project as if it were our own.
AboutPage.ideaStudio: We are an independent studio. We work with businesses, creators and communities, in Spanish and in English.
AboutPage.principle1Text: Development, brand, video and community are managed together and to one standard.
AboutPage.principle2Text: We do not work with predefined packages. Every project is sized and quoted according to its requirements.
AboutPage.principle3Text: Before starting we document what is delivered, by when and under what warranty.
AboutPage.coversText: Any fault attributable to our work. It is fixed at no cost during the 30 days after delivery.
AboutPage.excludesText: Faults of external origin, such as changes in hosting or third-party services. They are handled through a new quote.

ContactPage.whatsappText: Build your request in the quote form and the chat opens with the message ready to send.
ContactPage.discordText: Write to us on the Kardenum server on Discord.
ContactPage.emailText: For formal proposals or if you prefer to write at your own pace.
ContactPage.quoteText: Five steps and your request is ready. If you are unsure about something, leave it as it is: we will work it out together.

ContactPage.after3Text: A proposal made to fit, with scope, deliverables and warranty.
